notes: Taḥwīl: the first branch ends at its co-transmitters; the second branch names Abu Mu'awiya and Muhammad b. Ubayd; «عن الأعمش، عن زيد بن وهب، قال قال عبد الله بن مسعود» is written once after the last branch and is shared.
«أبو معاوية» stands twice in the text, so each occurrence is numbered; Ibn Mas'ud relays the saying, the Prophet is the end.
